messages:
maya_p: Heads up — we hit a blocker in canary that requires a quick rollback but intent is to keep the change window short. I need to know who can prod-deploy for this team right now. @ops-oncall please advise.
alex-w: If it's a rollback we'll need deployer role or an explicit temporary approval. who from infra is available to sponsor?
samira: I'm out of office until 18:00 UTC. I can sponsor if it's after that.
jonathan: I can sponsor now. FYI we changed the approval flow last month (two-person sponsor for non-deployers).
ops-oncall: @maya_p @alex-w we can issue a 4-hour temporary sudo token for a named user, but policy requires: 1) ticket linked (INC/PR link) 2) sponsor acknowledgement in thread 3) MFA check. I can start the process.
maya_p: INC-2987 is the ticket — rolling back prod service-x to v1.9.2. @jonathan is sponsor here.
jonathan: I sponsor and confirm I've reviewed the rollback plan. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: Starting approval flow. Requesting 2nd sponsor/ops signoff and MFA check.
louise-sec: Quick security note — for rollback we must ensure the rollback image is pinned and artifact checksum matches release-candidates bucket before prod push. See https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-checks
alex-w: Deploy bot, can you run pre-flight checks and show the artifact checksum?
deploy-bot: preflight: running checks for service-x v1.9.2
```
sha256: ab12f3e4d5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2
image: gs://redwood-release-candidates/service-x/v1.9.2/image.tar.gz
status: artifact_ok
```
ops-oncall: MFA verified for @alex-w and @jonathan (TOTP confirmed). second sponsor is @alex-w — requirement satisfied. temp token TTL=4h, scope=deploy:service-x:prod, audit=enabled.
alex-w: Please attach the ticket and rollout notes to the audit log when issuing token.
ops-oncall: Token issued to @maya_p: TOKEN-ID 2f9a7b (expires in 4h). Audit link: https://redwood.internal/audit/2f9a7b
maya_p: Thanks. Executing rollback now: `/deploy service-x prod --version=v1.9.2 --ticket=INC-2987`
deploy-bot: Starting deployment: service-x -> prod, version v1.9.2, initiated by maya_p, token=2f9a7b
deploy-bot: streaming logs... 50% 
deploy-bot: streaming logs... 100%
deploy-bot: Deployment successful. rollout_id=rl-2026-380-73
maya_p: Verified service health checks are all green. latency/spikes back to baseline.
jonathan: Thanks everyone. Action items: 1) update the runbook with explicit temp-token fields and two-sponsor flow, 2) review who has deployer role in the org (possible rotation), 3) consider reducing temp token TTL to 2h. @louise-sec can you own #1?
louise-sec: I can take #1, will PR changes to runbook today.
ops-oncall: Logged audit: INC-2987 rollback, sponsors=[jonathan,alex-w], token=2f9a7b, artifact=ab12f3e4..., duration=4h.
maya_p: Closing thread. Great coordination. :tada:
